vivian_mkt: Quick preflight for Monday's "Optimizing Inference" webinar. Reg page live? Zoom recording and post-event flow owners?

omar_ops: Zoom config set: webinar mode, cloud record MP4 + SRT, co-hosts = @vivian_mkt,@kevin_prod. Waiting room on, attendee screen share off. Retention NA=90d, EMEA=30d.

rachel_growth: Registration page up with timezone auto-detect and GDPR checkbox. Added a dropdown: 'primary use case' -> maps to HubSpot property `use_case`. Also added utm params: utm_source=linkedin&utm_campaign=inference_launch.

kevin_prod: Clips plan: auto-run clipper for highlights based on speaker markers + manual 3x quick edits. Destination s3://redwood-marketing/webinars/2026-06-01/{event-id}/clips. I'll own clips.

vivian_mkt: Lead routing?

rachel_growth: Flow: registrant -> Clearbit enrich (zap) -> HubSpot upsert -> property-based routing. Live attendees with 'demo' or 'integration' interest -> AE alert within 12h. Replay viewers who view >1x or click pricing -> SDR follow-up at 48h.

omar_ops: Zoom bot created meeting ID 99887766. Cloud recording + transcript enabled. Recording link posts to #marketing when ready.

zoom-bot: Webinar scheduled. Meeting ID: 99887766. Recording: enabled. Transcript: enabled. Reminder emails scheduled (24h, 1h).

kevin_prod: Small ops: set Zoom retention to 90 days for NA. Also add watermark email on replay for EMEA.

rachel_growth: Test zap passed (sample lead enriched). Mapping sheet row 8 has queue map.

vivian_mkt: Social copy variants ready. One emphasizes benchmark story, one emphasizes live Q&A. We'll A/B on paid vs organic.

omar_ops: After event:
```
- confirm recording link within 1h
- download mp4 + srt
- run pii-scrub on transcript
- run clipper, upload clips
- post internal mp4 link + clips to #marketing
```
I'll confirm link.

vivian_mkt: Who monitors chat?

kevin_prod: I'll monitor chat and flag hot questions to @rachel_growth.

rachel_growth: I'll triage leads. Jam in a DM if someone asks for enterprise pricing.

vivian_mkt: Thanks team  final ask: add utm for paid partners: utm_source=partner&utm_campaign=opt-in. Done?

rachel_growth: Added. All green from growth. See you in rehearsal. :rocket:
